decision_record.calculation: Fixture: position opened 100h before evaluation, funding absent. Control: 0 exits (hours unknown). Treatment: deadline exit fires. A position 10h old stays open under both.
decision_record.comparison: Deadline exit as coded (hours_held/bars_held fields) vs desk position rows as produced (dispatcher/broker rows carry opened_at; cf. desk3/aster_crypto.py deriving age from opened_at).
decision_record.experiment: Fixture A/B on identical bars/positions/funding: ON = deadline exit with paired enhance_exp record; OFF = no exit. Blockers: TestLinkDeadlineDerived.
decision_record.mechanism: Risk/execution: the 96h deadline is the ONLY exit when funding is absent; on real position rows it was dead code, so the position — and its funding bleed — could run forever.
decision_record.transfer: Negative-funding squeeze on LINKUSDT: shorts pay funding while the breakout holds; the sleeve warehouses the squeeze for up to 96h, after which the design mandates exit regardless of funding data.

switch: extra.enh_aster_link_nfs_norm_vol.deadline_from_opened_at (or ctx.enhance) default ON; OFF restores field-only rule exactly
